protocol_amendment.reason: The first pre-start dry run failed before geometry or outcome inspection because CelesTrak returned HTTP 404 for five decayed/unavailable v3 objects. The successor retains every v3 target with a retrievable current TLE and changes no model, station, outcome or metric.

protocol_notes.primary_scope: Read-only shadow validation on public SatNOGS observations; no jobs are submitted.
protocol_notes.station_selection: High-volume stations in frozen v3 that were connected and available at registration.
protocol_notes.target_selection: Every frozen v3 target for which the pre-start CelesTrak availability check returned a valid current TLE.
protocol_notes.weather: Open-Meteo forecast snapshots are captured before passes; NASA POWER is retrospective sensitivity only.
protocol_notes.space_weather: NOAA SWPC Kp predictions are captured before passes; unavailable future intervals remain missing.
protocol_notes.hardware: SatNOGS antenna type/range snapshots are future-valid only; gain/noise stay missing without an older versioned local record.
protocol_notes.causal_boundary: A shadow run tests calibration and operational stability, not causal scheduler yield improvement.
